guidebook.role.description.brin:puppetee:
Aim at a corpse and press the ability key to turn it into a puppet.

Open your inventory to see crafted puppets. Click a puppet icon to start controlling it immediately. Your real body cannot move while you control it.

A puppet comes with a knife and a crowbar.

A puppet lasts 60 seconds and shows a weakness at second 45.

If a puppet is scrapped in any way other than you recalling it, your real body glows for 10 seconds. If the puppet is killed, you also get 15 seconds of slowness.

A used puppet vanishes and leaves no corpse.

After buying Self-Destruct from the shop, a controlled puppet dying causes a 3x3x3 explosion centred on itself.

If your real body dies, the puppet vanishes immediately.
guidebook.role.description.brin:stunt_do:
Open your inventory and choose a player to stand in for.

While you are standing in for that player, if they take fatal damage, you die in their place.
guidebook.role.description.brin:medium:
Spend gold to briefly commune with the dead.

While channelling, you can talk with the dead to gather information.
guidebook.role.description.brin:eavesdro:
The Eavesdropper can monitor all chat messages
regardless of distance.

Spend {skill_cost} coins to pull one non-Medium player
into a temporary voice channel with you.
The channel lasts {skill_duration_seconds} seconds,
and neither player can leave it voluntarily.

Ability cooldown: {skill_cooldown_seconds} seconds.
guidebook.role.description.brin:watchman:
You have permanent night vision.

You can see players trapped by beast traps (Beast Trapper, from Brin's Wathe) or mines (Bomber, from Brin's Wathe).

You can see beast traps and they can catch you. You cannot see mines, but mines cannot trap you.

Spend gold, aim at a trapped player, and press the ability key to free them.
guidebook.role.description.brin:beast_tr:
Press the ability key and spend gold to place a beast trap.

A trapped player stays locked in place until they die.

Killers cannot trigger beast traps.

You can buy extra traps in the shop. Buying one ignores the trap limit and places a trap at your feet.

The Survival Expert (from Brin's Wathe) can see beast traps.
guidebook.role.description.brin:beastcat:
The Trapper deploys deadly traps.

Press the ability key and spend {skill_cost} coins to deploy one.
Only you, your teammates and the Survival Expert can see the trap.
A trapped player remains immobilized until death.
Each catch pays you {trap_catch_reward} coins.

Ability-placed traps are capped at {trap_limit} at once.
The shop Extra Trap costs {extra_trap_price} coins and plants one at your feet, ignoring that cap.
Ability cooldown: {skill_cooldown_seconds} seconds.
guidebook.role.description.brin:nightmar:
The Nightmare starts with one shield layer and can see sleeping players.

You can plant fear in sleeping players. Each planting grants one extra shield layer, up to two.

Planted players cannot kill the Nightmare.

You can assign a Sleep task to living players.

When every member of the killer team is dead, if the Nightmare is still alive, Nightmare Hour begins.

Nightmare Hour gives the Nightmare a knife, Killer Instinct, and the killer shop.

Before Nightmare Hour, the Nightmare follows the Killers' result. After Nightmare Hour, the Nightmare settles independently.

Win condition during Nightmare Hour: plant every living player, or kill everyone.
guidebook.role.description.brin:illusion:
Press the ability key to spawn two doubles. They always face east and west.

While the ability lasts, press the key again to switch your possessed view: east double, then west double, then your body.

While controlling a double, your body stays where it is. If your body dies, every double vanishes at once.

Doubles can interact and can kill.
guidebook.role.description.brin:sniper:
While the ability is active, you cannot use instinct and you glow.

Press the ability key to enter aiming mode. Press Esc to leave. You cannot move while aiming. Press the ability key again to fire a wall-piercing shot with a max range of 300 blocks.

After using the ability you glow for a while. Complete tasks to restore it.
guidebook.role.description.brin:berserke:
The good team cannot kill you (except during Cowboy Time).

Save enough coins to buy Infinite Psycho Mode.

During Infinite Psycho Mode, the Berserker can only die by falling out of the play area.

When no other killers or independently-settled neutrals are left alive, the Berserker enters Infinite Psycho Mode immediately.

The Berserker wins by killing everyone.
guidebook.role.description.brin:archivis:
Aim at a corpse and press the ability key to spend gold and seal it.

A sealed corpse cannot be dissolved by the Cleaner (from Kin's Wathe) or revived by the Necromancer (from Stupid Express).

The Archivist can also see through fake corpses made by the Bodymaker (from Kin's Wathe) and disguises from the Mortician (from Brin's Wathe).
guidebook.role.description.brin:boneharv:
Passive: corpses of players you kill stay invisible for 20 seconds.

You can also buy a Bone Knife from the shop. Use it on a corpse that still has bones to strip them and gain one shield layer.

There is no theoretical limit to how many shields you can have.
item.brinswathe.bone_knife.used: You removed the bones and gained one shield layer.
guidebook.role.description.brin:compensa:
When a Civilian tries to kill you, you take their place and survive as a new Civilian.

When a Killer tries to kill you, you take their place and survive as a new Killer.

When someone who is not Neutral tries to kill you, you both die.
guidebook.role.description.brin:gambler:
Spend a set amount of coins, then aim at a player to place a bet. While your target is still alive, you can switch bets.

Your bet target is permanently highlighted to you.

If your target dies after the bet, you are poisoned. That poison cannot be cured.

If your target survives for 6 minutes, you win whether you are alive or dead.
guidebook.role.description.brin:penitent:
The Penitent must personally kill players of the target role. Reach the required kill count to win independently.

If the Killers win and the Penitent has not met the win condition, the Penitent follows the Killers' result. If the Penitent has met the win condition, the Penitent wins independently.

Killing a player of the correct role grants one shield. Killing the wrong player poisons you.

Don't worry: you can buy Identity Hints and Antidote from the shop. Antidote is used as soon as you buy it.
guidebook.role.description.brin:terroris:
When you are shot to death, a 5x5x5 explosion triggers.

If the explosion kills 4 or more players, the Terrorist survives.
guidebook.role.description.brin:zhangshi:
This is Haibao's sponsored role. Thanks, Bao.
Press the ability key to boost your speed for 10 seconds.

You can also buy Xuezi. Eating it instantly uses the ability, ignoring cooldown and cost.

After eating Xuezi, the ability lasts until Zhangshi dies. While it is active you are poisoned and have one shield layer (the shield does not block poison).

If you get a kill before the poison kills you, the poison is cleared and the ability ends 5 seconds later.
guidebook.role.description.brin:stalker:
Aim at a player and press the ability key to track them.

After the cooldown, you can switch your final target.

You can always see that player's icon until they die.
message.brinswathe.stalker.tracking: Now stalking %s; switching targets has a %ss cooldown.
message.brinswathe.stalker.tracking_unli: Now stalking %s. Your Unlimited modifier removes the cooldown (configured: %ss).
guidebook.role.description.brin:avenger: After you witness someone die, you briefly gain instinct.
guidebook.role.description.brin:cowboy:
After you have enough gold, choose a player to start a western showdown (open your inventory and pick their head).

During the showdown, players can only use the cowboy revolver, and active and passive abilities cannot be used (not fully tested, but Zealot passives are unaffected).

When only one player is left alive on the showdown field, cowboy time ends and everyone returns to the game area.

If neither player kills the other before the showdown timer runs out, both die.

All drops from cowboy time are moved to where the Cowboy stood before entering cowboy time, after it ends.

Cowboy time does not apply gunfire punishment.

Warning: if Cowboy is enabled and you want to play western showdowns, prepare a field at Y 118 or above, then set both players' spawn coordinates and the spectator spawn in the config. Players face east/west by default, so an east-west field is recommended. You can also just use the train.

guidebook.role.description.brin:morticia:
The Mortician can disguise as a corpse.

Moving while disguised breaks the disguise.

If you kill a player within 5 seconds of dropping the disguise, the knife does not go on cooldown.

The Archivist (from Brin's Wathe) can tell your fake corpse from a real one.
guidebook.role.description.brin:bomber:
This is Maomao's sponsored role. Thanks, Mo.
The Bomber cannot buy a knife, but grenades cost less.

You can buy bombs and mines.

Bomb: hold a bomb and right-click another player to plant it on them. After 15 seconds they get a warning: 30s until detonation. They can right-click another player to pass the bomb. Blast size is 2x2x2.

Mine: hold a mine and right-click to place it at your feet. Stepping on it roots you; move and it explodes, but it only kills the person who stepped on it. There is a sound cue when someone steps on it.

Bombs and mines are invisible to others while held.

The Survival Expert (from Brin's Wathe) cannot see mines, but can free a player who stepped on one.

If a Bomber explosion hits a Terrorist (from Brin's Wathe), that Terrorist also explodes.

The killer team does not trigger bombs.
